recommendation_summary: Right now, the reply has the user adopt one review-assignment rule: each PR goes to an available authorized approver and gets reassigned when that reviewer is unavailable. PRs waiting on the absent lead are moved to either qualified engineer first. Then the existing tracker is used to check approval delays on the next completed changes. It suggests no optional additions and leaves no stated need unmet.
